about: Hand-authored map grid for the KH1 read-only map. One (col,row) cell per room id; row 0 is the top. Edges are NOT authored here: build_kh1_data.py takes them from docs/research/kh1-data-draft/rooms.json adjacency, so unknown links stay out. Cells were placed so that no edge runs through another room's cell and the guessed edges do not cross.

Neverland.note: Pirate Ship deck (8) at the hub; Clock Tower above it, the hold rooms along the bottom. Rooms 10-11 are unnamed in every source and are left out (the app shows 'Room N').

Hollow Bastion.note: Rising Falls and Base Level at the bottom, the castle interior in the middle, the chapel and Dark Depths on top. Rooms with no known link (9, 12, 13, 16) sit beside their same-name rooms.

End of the World.note: 7 columns, pans. Rows 0-1: Gate to the Dark then Final Dimension 1-12 (their order is unknown, so no edges between them). World Terminus (15) is a hub with the ten portals and Evil Grounds around it; the Evil Grounds -> Final Rest -> Final Door chain runs along the bottom. Unlinked finale rooms fill the left block.
